content: You do not have to struggle to reach God, but you do have to struggle to tear away the self-created veil that hides Him from you.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda
explanation:
The divine presence is not a distant, aloof entity residing beyond the stars that must be reached through exhausting physical journeys. It is the very fabric of life, closer to you than your own breathing. The only obstacle is the thick veil of mental noise, sensory addiction, and restless desires that we constantly spin around our awareness.

Spiritual practice is not about building something new; it is the joyful, disciplined removal of the mental dust obscuring the diamond within.
practicalInsight: Identify one habitual distraction (such as endless scrolling) that clouds your mental clarity, and replace it with five minutes of silent breath meditation today.
reflectionPrompt: What self-created habits or mental noise are currently veiling your direct experience of inner peace?
